executive_summary: Connect the existing design-agent to Stage-20 review via a venture-stage adapter, adding usability/accessibility/journey_coherence findings, WARN-capped so no experience finding can FAIL AltifyAI's first traversal.

functional_requirements.requirement: Extend FINDING_CATEGORIES with three experience categories
functional_requirements.description: Add 'usability', 'accessibility', 'journey_coherence' to lib/eva/quality-findings/finding-shape.js FINDING_CATEGORIES (line 44-57), mirroring the existing vision-compliance pair precedent. validateFindingShape() (line 109) must accept the new categories with no other behavior change.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: FINDING_CATEGORIES array contains 'usability', 'accessibility', 'journey_coherence'
AC-2: validateFindingShape() accepts a finding with each new category and rejects an unknown category, unchanged from today
AC-3: Unit test asserts the three new strings are present and existing categories are unmodified (no accidental renames)

functional_requirements.requirement: WARN-cap the three experience categories in the Stage-20 verdict formula
functional_requirements.description: In lib/eva/stage-templates/analysis-steps/stage-20-code-quality.js (verdict formula at line 782-785), exclude findings whose category is usability/accessibility/journey_coherence from the hasCritical/hasHigh scan that drives PASS/WARN/FAIL, while still persisting them at their true severity via persistAnalyzerFindings (line 793). A critical-severity experience finding must never flip the verdict to FAIL.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A seeded critical-severity finding in an experience category does not change verdict from PASS/WARN to FAIL
AC-2: A seeded critical-severity finding in a NON-experience category still produces FAIL, unchanged from today (no regression to the existing formula for other categories)
AC-3: The persisted finding row (venture_quality_findings) retains its true (uncapped) severity, distinguishable from a capped verdict-contribution

functional_requirements.description: A new adapter module invokes the existing design-agent in a standalone mode (venture_id + live deployment URL, no SD context required) using a venture-stage prompt variant built on the ehg-redesign skill's scan/rank/fix rubric skeleton, retargeted from 'existing UI code' to 'Stage-15 experience artifacts (wireframes, IA, user-journey) vs. the live deployment'. Reuses scripts/execute-subagent.js --code DESIGN patterns where possible; extends only what is needed for the no-SD invocation path.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Adapter run log shows it fetched BLUEPRINT_USER_JOURNEY and BLUEPRINT_WIREFRAME_SCREENS artifacts via artifact-persistence-service.js for the target venture_id
AC-2: Adapter run log shows it fetched/considered the live deployment URL as review input
AC-3: Adapter can run with no strategic_directives_v2 row involved (verified: no createSD/SD write side effect during a standalone run)
AC-4: Adapter model-usage self-log call (track-model-usage.js) falls back to 'STANDALONE'/'UNKNOWN' sd_id per the design-agent.partial convention for a no-SD run

functional_requirements.requirement: Findings + cost telemetry persisted queryably for Solomon
functional_requirements.description: Persist each adapter run's raw findings (by category/severity) and time/token cost telemetry in a new lightweight table (e.g. venture_experience_review_runs) queryable directly by Solomon for his chairman report — sidesteps the documented dead cost-capture gap in sub_agent_execution_results/model_usage_log (0/1904 rows, field-name drift). No RLS/auth surface beyond standard read access consistent with other quality-findings tables.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A migration creates venture_experience_review_runs with venture_id, run_id, findings_count_by_category, severity_breakdown, duration_ms, token_usage (input/output/total), cost_usd, adapter_version, run_mode, created_at
AC-2: A completed adapter run inserts exactly one row queryable by venture_id immediately after the run
AC-3: A SQL query against the table can compute: findings by category/severity, valid-and-actionable fraction placeholder field, cost, without joining any other table

functional_requirements.requirement: Out-of-band advisory annex runbook (documented fallback path)
functional_requirements.description: Because no annex/advisory-attachment pattern exists in the codebase today, document and dry-run a runbook: a standalone script invocation of the adapter that writes findings with run_mode='out_of_band_annex' and does NOT touch the live Stage-20 gating path, for use if AltifyAI reaches Stage 20 before this capability lands (chairman's explicit timing condition: never delay the venture).
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A documented runbook (docs/) describes the exact command to run the adapter out-of-band against a venture already at/past Stage 20
AC-2: A dry-run of the runbook against a test venture writes findings tagged run_mode='out_of_band_annex' with zero diffs to any stage-23 surface and zero writes to the live Stage-20 verdict path
AC-3: The dry-run completes without delaying or blocking any other venture-stage operation (no lock/claim taken on the venture's stage progression)

technical_requirements.requirement: No new persistent agent/executive role registered
technical_requirements.rationale: Scope item 7 explicitly forbids a new agent role; the design-agent subagent definition (.claude/agents/design-agent.partial) and its registration must remain unchanged — only a new invocation mode (standalone) and a new prompt variant are added.

technical_requirements.requirement: Zero diffs to any Stage-23 surface
technical_requirements.rationale: Scope item 6/7: Stage 24 remains the sole decision authority and Stage 23 is untouched by this SD. Enforced by a repo-wide diff check in CI/test against the Stage-23 file set as part of FR-2's test coverage.

technical_requirements.requirement: Verdict-formula change is additive and backward-compatible
technical_requirements.rationale: stage-20-code-quality.js:782-785 is a shared formula also exercised by the existing stage-20-journey-walk-verdict.test.js (mirrors the formula verbatim). The category-exclusion change must preserve existing behavior for every currently-registered category so that test (and any other caller relying on the formula) is unaffected except for the three new categories.

system_architecture.overview: A new standalone adapter wraps the existing design-agent with a venture-stage prompt variant, reading Stage-15 experience artifacts + a live deployment URL, and writing findings through the existing Stage-20 quality-findings pipeline (extended with 3 new categories) with a WARN-cap carve-out in the verdict formula. Run telemetry lands in a new dedicated table for Solomon's reporting, independent of the two broken/unsuited cost tables identified during exploration.

components.name: finding-shape.js category extension
components.responsibility: Accept the 3 new experience categories in the shared finding schema

components.name: Stage-20 verdict WARN-cap
components.responsibility: Exclude experience-category findings from the FAIL-driving severity scan while persisting true severity

components.name: Design-agent venture-stage adapter
components.responsibility: Standalone invocation of design-agent against Stage-15 artifacts + live URL, using an ehg-redesign-derived scan/rank/fix prompt variant
components.technology: Node.js CLI script, Task-tool design-agent subagent

components.name: venture_experience_review_runs table
components.responsibility: Queryable persistence of raw findings + cost/time telemetry per run

components.name: Out-of-band annex runbook
components.responsibility: Documented + dry-run fallback path for running the adapter without touching live Stage-20 gating

system_architecture.data_flow: Adapter fetches Stage-15 artifacts (artifact-persistence-service.js, keyed by venture_id + artifact_class) and the live deployment URL -> invokes design-agent (standalone mode) with the venture-stage prompt variant -> normalizes findings into the shared finding shape (3 new categories) -> writes findings via the existing persistAnalyzerFindings path (in-traversal) OR a parallel out-of-band write tagged run_mode='out_of_band_annex' -> Stage-20 verdict formula excludes experience categories from FAIL/WARN scan but PASS/WARN/FAIL for non-experience findings is unchanged -> run telemetry (findings summary + cost/time) is written to venture_experience_review_runs, queryable by Solomon.
integration_points: design-agent subagent (.claude/agents/design-agent.partial) via a new standalone invocation path

test_scenarios.scenario: Three new categories are accepted by the finding-shape validator
test_scenarios.given: A finding object with finding_category='usability' (and separately 'accessibility', 'journey_coherence')
test_scenarios.then: The finding passes shape validation with no error, matching the existing behavior for a pre-existing category

test_scenarios.scenario: Critical experience finding cannot FAIL the Stage-20 verdict
test_scenarios.given: allFindings contains one finding with category='usability' and severity='critical', and no other critical/high findings
test_scenarios.when: The Stage-20 verdict formula (or its exported/testable equivalent) computes the verdict
test_scenarios.then: The verdict is PASS or WARN, never FAIL

test_scenarios.scenario: Critical non-experience finding still FAILs (no regression)
test_scenarios.given: allFindings contains one finding with category outside the 3 new experience categories and severity='critical'
test_scenarios.when: The Stage-20 verdict formula computes the verdict
test_scenarios.then: The verdict is FAIL, exactly as before this change

test_scenarios.scenario: Adapter fetches real Stage-15 artifacts and live URL for a standalone run
test_scenarios.given: A venture_id with existing BLUEPRINT_USER_JOURNEY and BLUEPRINT_WIREFRAME_SCREENS artifacts and a deployment URL
test_scenarios.when: The adapter is invoked standalone (no SD context)
test_scenarios.then: The adapter's run log/output references the fetched artifact IDs and the deployment URL, and no strategic_directives_v2 row is created or modified

test_scenarios.scenario: Run telemetry is persisted and queryable
test_scenarios.given: A completed adapter run against a test venture
test_scenarios.then: Exactly one row exists with non-null findings_count_by_category, duration_ms, and token_usage

test_scenarios.scenario: Out-of-band annex dry-run touches nothing live
test_scenarios.given: A test venture already past Stage 20
test_scenarios.when: The out-of-band annex runbook command is dry-run against it
test_scenarios.then: Findings are written tagged run_mode='out_of_band_annex', zero diffs appear under any stage-23 file path, and the venture's live Stage-20 verdict/status is unchanged

test_scenarios.scenario: No new agent role is registered
test_scenarios.given: The repo's sub-agent/agent registry (.claude/agents manifest and any leo_sub_agents-equivalent registration)
test_scenarios.when: This SD's changes are diffed against the registry
test_scenarios.then: No new agent/role entry is added; design-agent's existing registration is unchanged

acceptance_criteria: usability/accessibility/journey_coherence are present in FINDING_CATEGORIES and accepted by validateFindingShape()

A critical-severity finding in any of the 3 new categories cannot produce a FAIL verdict on the first (or any) Stage-20 traversal, while a critical finding in an existing category still FAILs exactly as before
The design-agent adapter runs standalone against a venture_id + live deployment URL, demonstrably consuming Stage-15 journey/wireframe artifacts, with zero SD-context writes
Zero diffs to any Stage-23 surface and zero new agent/role registrations anywhere in the change set
Findings + time/token cost telemetry for each run are persisted in a queryable table Solomon can read directly
An out-of-band advisory-annex runbook is documented and dry-run-verified to attach findings without delaying or gating the venture's live traversal

risks.risk: Modifying the shared Stage-20 verdict formula (stage-20-code-quality.js:782-785) regresses existing category behavior
risks.mitigation: Implement via category-exclusion (filter out the 3 new categories before the hasCritical/hasHigh scan) rather than rewriting the formula; add a regression test asserting existing categories are unaffected, and run the existing stage-20-journey-walk-verdict.test.js unchanged against the new code
risks.rollback_plan: Revert the verdict-formula diff only (finding-fabric category addition and the new adapter/table are independently revertable); the formula change is the single highest-risk, smallest-surface commit and should ship as its own PR for easy isolated rollback

risks.risk: No existing cost-telemetry table works, and the new venture_experience_review_runs table could duplicate a fix already planned for the documented dead cost-capture gap
risks.mitigation: Explicitly scope venture_experience_review_runs as narrow to this SD's own runs (not a general-purpose cost-capture fix); read database/migrations/20260716_cost_governor_log.sql before building to confirm it is not already the intended fix, per the exploration's open item #3
risks.rollback_plan: Table is additive-only and unused by any other system; drop-safe if superseded by a broader cost-capture fix later

risks.risk: Standalone design-agent invocation (no SD context) diverges from the existing execute-subagent.js --code DESIGN contract, creating two invocation paths that drift out of sync
risks.mitigation: Build the standalone path as a thin wrapper that reuses the same underlying design-agent prompt/execution logic as execute-subagent.js, parameterizing SD-context vs. venture_id-context rather than duplicating the invocation code
risks.rollback_plan: The standalone adapter is a new, isolated script; removing it does not affect the existing SD-scoped DESIGN invocation path

phases.phase: Unit A: Finding-fabric extension + verdict WARN-cap
phases.description: Add the 3 categories to finding-shape.js, implement the category-exclusion WARN-cap in stage-20-code-quality.js's verdict formula, and cover both with unit/regression tests. Smallest, highest-risk, independently-shippable commit.
deliverables: Verdict formula excludes experience categories from FAIL/WARN scan

phases.phase: Unit B: Design-agent stage-adapter + telemetry table
phases.description: Build the standalone venture-stage adapter (prompt variant derived from the ehg-redesign rubric skeleton), the venture_experience_review_runs migration, and wire the adapter's output through the extended finding fabric.
deliverables: Adapter run wired to persist findings + telemetry

phases.description: Document and dry-run the fallback runbook so AltifyAI's Stage-20 timing risk is covered regardless of when this capability lands relative to the venture's traversal.
deliverables: Dry-run verification against a test venture (TS-6)

technical_decisions: WARN-cap implemented as category-exclusion from the verdict scan (not severity-clamping at emission) so Solomon's raw-findings query retains true severity per the exploration's recommendation
Standalone adapter reuses design-agent's existing prompt/execution machinery rather than duplicating it, to avoid a second drifting implementation

A new dedicated telemetry table is created rather than retrofitting sub_agent_execution_results or model_usage_log, both of which are documented-unsuited (no cost column / wrong required-field shape) per exploration findings

consumers.name: Solomon (chairman-report duty)
consumers.interaction: Queries venture_experience_review_runs directly for findings by category/severity, cost, and material-improvement verdict
consumers.frequency: Once per Stage-20 traversal that includes an experience review, plus any out-of-band annex run

consumers.name: Stage-20 quality-findings pipeline
consumers.interaction: Consumes the adapter's findings as additional entries in allFindings, subject to the WARN-cap

consumers.name: Stage 24 (decision authority)
consumers.interaction: Reads the Stage-20 verdict (including the capped experience findings) unchanged from today; no new authority granted

dependencies.name: Stage-15 artifact generators (wireframe/IA/user-journey)
dependencies.contract: Adapter reads via artifact-persistence-service.js keyed by venture_id + artifact_class
dependencies.failure_handling: Missing/absent Stage-15 artifacts for a venture -> adapter records a low-confidence/INCONCLUSIVE finding rather than failing the run

dependencies.name: design-agent subagent
dependencies.contract: Adapter invokes the existing design-agent prompt/execution path in a new standalone mode
dependencies.failure_handling: A failed/errored design-agent invocation must not produce a false PASS -- surfaced as a run-level error, not silently dropped findings

dependencies.name: Stage-20 verdict pipeline
dependencies.contract: Adapter findings enter allFindings through the existing persistence path, subject to the new category-exclusion in the verdict formula
dependencies.failure_handling: If the adapter's findings can't be normalized to the shared finding shape, the run must fail loudly rather than silently omit them

data_contracts.schema: Existing finding-shape.js schema, category ∈ {usability, accessibility, journey_coherence}, all other fields unchanged
data_contracts.versioning: Additive-only category list; no breaking change to existing consumers

data_contracts.schema: venture_id, run_id, findings_count_by_category (jsonb), severity_breakdown (jsonb), duration_ms, token_usage (jsonb), cost_usd, adapter_version, run_mode, created_at
data_contracts.validation: NOT NULL on venture_id/run_id/run_mode; run_mode CHECK IN ('in_traversal','out_of_band_annex')
data_contracts.versioning: New table, versioned via adapter_version column for future schema evolution

runtime_config.deployment_considerations: No new environment variables or feature flags; the standalone adapter is a CLI script invoked on demand (in-traversal call site or out-of-band runbook), not a background service.

monitoring: venture_experience_review_runs row count and duration_ms per run
Stage-20 verdict distribution before/after this change (confirm no unexpected FAIL-rate shift for non-experience categories)
alerts: An adapter run erroring instead of completing (surfaced via its own run-level error handling, not a silent PASS)
observability_rollout.rollout_strategy: WARN-capped pilot scoped to AltifyAI's first traversal per the chairman's authorization; no feature flag needed since the change is additive (new categories + exclusion in the verdict formula) and the standalone adapter is opt-in by invocation
observability_rollout.rollback_trigger: Any regression in existing (non-experience-category) Stage-20 verdict behavior, or the adapter producing findings that cannot be normalized to the shared shape
observability_rollout.rollback_procedure: Revert the verdict-formula exclusion commit (Unit A) independently of the adapter/table (Unit B/C), since Unit A is the only change touching a shared, already-tested code path

patterns_identified: FINDING_CATEGORIES extension is a pure array-append, precedented by the vision-compliance category pair
Stage-20's verdict formula is inline, unexported logic with no existing category-scoped severity capping mechanism
Stage-15 artifacts are unified-registry artifacts fetched via artifact-persistence-service.js keyed by artifact_class
design-agent's invocation contract today assumes an SD context; a standalone venture_id+URL mode is new work
No working cost-telemetry table exists to reuse (both candidate tables are unsuited or dead)
key_decisions: WARN-cap via category-exclusion from the verdict scan, not severity-clamping, to preserve true severity for Solomon's reporting
New dedicated telemetry table rather than retrofitting a broken existing table
Standalone adapter as a thin wrapper reusing design-agent's existing execution path, not a duplicate implementation
